summary: Auto-generated format support matrix from the live adapter registry, grouped by canonical content kind with adapter id, output extensions, and human label. It documents CLI listing, inspection, conversion, and validation, with SillyTavern CCv3 as the default portable character shape for thin hosts. The current registry has nine character, six lorebook, four persona, four preset, five regex-set, one quick-reply, and one prompt-format adapter. The quick-reply row is SillyTavern's version 2 qrList JSON format and promises semantic JSON preservation, not byte identity. Packs have one adapter, image-pack, a ZIP of pictures; HTML documents remain a canonical studio kind with no foreign format adapters and are intentionally canonical-only drawings. Notes explain content-sniff detection, fixture-proven same-format round trips, honest cross-format loss reporting, and sample locations. Because the page is generated, counts and rows change only with the registry.

sections.title: How to use
sections.summary: Documents the primary CLI entry points for format work: bun run bunraku formats to list adapters, bunraku inspect on a card path, bunraku convert with --to for a target such as sillytavern, and bunraku validate on card JSON. The default portable character shape for thin hosts including C.AI Tools dumps and Crushon import is SillyTavern CCv3 through the sillytavern adapter.

sections.title: Characters (9)
sections.summary: Nine character adapters. agnai writes .json for Agnai Agnaistic. backyard writes .json for Backyard.ai or Faraday legacy json. byaf writes .byaf Backyard archives. lumiverse writes .json and .charx for ST plus modules. pygmalion writes .json and .png flat character. risu writes .charx zip with card.json and assets. rolecall writes .json for RoleCall v3 png or json cards. sillytavern writes .json for SillyTavern CCv2 and v3 png or json. vaud-json writes .json as Bunraku native. All are kind character.

sections.title: Lorebooks (7)
sections.summary: Seven lorebook adapters. agnai-lorebook writes .json Agnai memory books. marinara-lorebook writes .json native .marinara.json export. novelai-lorebook writes .lorebook for NovelAI native export or json. risu-lorebook writes .json RisuAI native export. rolecall-lorebook writes .json RoleCall v1 export. rolecall-compendium writes .json RoleCall compendium export. sillytavern-lorebook writes .json SillyTavern world info worldbook. All are kind lorebook.

sections.title: Personas (4)
sections.summary: Four persona adapters, all writing .json. lumiverse-persona is a Lumiverse account object. marinara-persona carries theming and stat bars sealed. rolecall-persona is rcpersona or RC persona-card export. sillytavern-persona is a SillyTavern personas backup where the default persona is primary and the rest ride sealed.

sections.title: Presets (4)
sections.summary: Four preset adapters, all writing .json. lumiverse-preset imports a wrapper and exports as an ST flat preset. marinara-preset is Marinara-Engine marinara_preset export. rolecall-preset is RoleCall preset export with ST grammar plus macros, choice groups, and readme. sillytavern-preset is SillyTavern completion preset as flat json.

sections.title: Regex script sets (5)
sections.summary: Five regex script set adapters, all writing .json. lumiverse-regex is a versioned export file. marinara-regex is an API dump array. risu-regex covers .risum module or customscript array. rolecall-regex is a chat-pipeline find and replace set. sillytavern-regex is a bare array or card extensions.regex_scripts. All are kind regex.

sections.title: Packs (1)
sections.summary: Packs list one format adapter in the live matrix: image-pack, a ZIP of pictures (png, jpg, gif, webp) and nothing else, read into a pack with one item per picture labeled by file name, so a folder such as SillyTavern backgrounds comes in through the Library import. A ZIP that holds anything else is not claimed. Writing a pack back to a ZIP works only for inline pictures.

sections.title: Htmldocs (0)
sections.summary: Drawings list zero format adapters, and unlike the other empty kinds that is by design rather than pending work. An htmldoc is an HTML document the agent authors and the studio keeps as a piece so it can be named, grouped, duplicated and deleted like anything else; it is canonical-only and there is no foreign app to import one from or export one to. The kind exists for storage and for the HTML View tab, which draws it with scripts and network access off. If a platform ever ships a comparable saved-page format, an adapter belongs here.

sections.title: Quick replies (1)
sections.summary: The live matrix lists one quick-reply adapter. sillytavern-quickreply reads and writes JSON files for SillyTavern Quick Reply sets, using the version 2 qrList container. It is a dedicated quickreply adapter rather than a character, preset, or regex reader, and its declared output extension is JSON. The matrix derives this row from the registered adapter, so the section count, id, kind, writable extension, and descriptive label change only when the runtime registry changes.

sections.title: Prompt formats (1)
sections.summary: The live matrix lists one prompt-format adapter. sillytavern-promptformat reads and writes JSON for SillyTavern instruct and context templates, and the master wrapper holding both, as one promptformat piece. The row comes from the registered adapter, so it changes only when the registry does.

sections.title: Notes
sections.summary: Detection is content-sniff, not only extension; prefer bunraku label when unsure. Same-format round-trips aim for lossless where fixtures prove it, see adapter tests and samples/. Cross-format convert keeps what the target can express; use export honesty in the studio UI for drop notes. Dropped or skipped host-native bags such as Character.AI and Crushon should use Default CCv3 via the sillytavern adapter.

sections.title: Samples
sections.summary: Lists sample fixture folders under samples/. sillytavern holds CCv2/v3 and Seraphina.png. rolecall has RC character plus lorebook. risu has .charx and card json. agnai, backyard .byaf, pygmalion classic flat, lumiverse ST plus Lumi extensions, chub ST plus extensions.chub, marinara lorebook envelope plus prompt preset, and novelai lorebook complete the corpus map.
